name: echarts
modifications: None; copied exact distribution, licence and notice bytes from the official npm package. No npm dependencies or lifecycle scripts were installed or executed.

tested.policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'

limitations: The isolated runtime test covers a Canvas scatter chart, a richText tooltip and resizing in the listed Chromium build. Other browsers, renderers and optional components need integration testing.
Use local scripts and external stylesheets under script-src/style-src self; do not add unsafe-inline or unsafe-eval for this integration.
Do not use tooltip.renderMode html, toolbox dataView, untrusted raw HTML, tooltip.extraCssText or externally sourced image icons.
The official bundle sets some trusted CSSOM cssText internally; this caused no CSP violations in the tested browser. The vendor distribution is unmodified.

The full bundle includes a legacy GeoJSON parser new Function fallback when native JSON.parse is unavailable. It was not exercised in the tested modern browser; provide parsed GeoJSON objects if maps are added.
